5986.title: Mobile WebView filters local inline documents before app policy
5986.rootCauseOneLine: The installed WebView default whitelist rejects local-document subframes before the shell navigation callback can allow them.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses gate mismatch; top-frame safety needs coverage
prReviews.topFinding: Broadening blob admission also allows a same-origin top-frame blob through the existing root-profile navigation predicate; linked patch was not executed.

5986.proposedFix: Align preliminary gate with intended local subframes while explicitly retaining top-frame navigation restrictions and iframe sandboxing.
5986.caveats: Linux cannot run iOS Simulator. Two clean JavaScript-boundary reproductions, not native visual verification. Full test and exact output are embedded in HTML per reports repository policy. Existing linked PR 5988 prevents a duplicate fix.
